summary: Built the strings/GUID orientation index for Revit 2026 .rvt. src/rvt/strings_scan.py sweeps every inflated gzip member, the raw metadata streams (incl. ProjectInformation zip → project.xml) and the raw gaps between carved Partitions gzip members for UTF-16LE strings (≥4), ASCII (≥5), text+binary GUIDs (Windows bytes_le layout) and a curated needle list seeded with each file's BasicFileInfo/ProjectInformation values; it emits per-hit JSONL (file/stream/member/offset/encoding/class/len_prefixed/text/32-byte ctx). Ran on racbasic (237,508 string records, 1,469 GUID hits) and rstbasic (151,903 / 1,386). docs/streams/08-strings-map.md documents: the universal AString encoding (u32 char count + UTF-16LE, no NUL, unaligned); a per-stream summary; a top-100 located-strings table; the BasicFileInfo binary layout with exact field offsets; cross-references of BasicFileInfo GUIDs (Unique Document GUID = Global/History record 0, verified in both files); and firm conclusions on where names/parameter values live (Partitions element records; ProjectInformation values fully decoded as an int64 BuiltInParameter-id → AString map in Partitions/15 member 095).
key_findings: Every user-visible string in every stream is an AString: uint32 LE char count + UTF-16LE code units, no terminator, unaligned (worked example 'Wall - Timber Clad' at racbasic Partitions/15 member 058 +0x132dd, len prefix 0x12); null strings are written as ff ff ff ff.

Element type & instance names live ONLY inside element records in the Partitions/<N> gzip blocks — Global/ElemTable and Global/History contain zero strings; Global/Latest holds only document-level names (unit-schema JSON, param definitions, colour-fill schemes, browser organisation), not element names.

Level element names: racbasic Partitions/15 member 043 +0x37be ('Level 1', len prefix 07 00 00 00 at +0x37ba) and 044 +0x182d8 ('Level 2'); the name is denormalised onto ~26 referencing view records as pattern `7f 9e f0 ff ff ff ff ff 01 00 00 00 | 07 00 00 00 'Level 1' | e3 00 00 00` where 0xe3=227 is the Level 1 ElementId.

Grid name 'Grid 1' at Partitions/15 member 514 +0x1a701 (len 06 00 00 00); wall type name 'Wall - Timber Clad' at 058 +0x132e1 preceded by a 2-entry id→AString param map at +0x131c4 (id -1140934 → 'F10' assembly code; id -1015223 → the 72-char type description at +0x131e6). In rstbasic member 086 +0x9d the same class record stores family AString 'Basic Wall' then type name 'CL_W1'; racbasic stores a null (ff ff ff ff) family name — explains 0 'Basic Wall' hits in racbasic vs 45 in rstbasic.

Parameter VALUES live inline in the owning element record as an (int64 paramId → AString) map keyed by the public Revit BuiltInParameter ids: racbasic ProjectInformation element at Partitions/15 member 095 +0x5580, count 10: -1019008→'Autodesk' (org), -1019007→'', -1019006→'Samuel Macalister sample house design', -1019005→'Samuel Macalister', -1006321→'Issue Date', -1006320→'Project Status', -1006319→'Autodesk' (CLIENT_NAME), -1006318→'Enter address here', -1006317→'Sample House' (PROJECT_NAME, str @+0x56d0), -1006316→'001-00' (PROJECT_NUMBER). project.xml (PartAtom) is a redundant mirror; in rstbasic the element value (member 030 +0xcb1) is empty while its XML still says 'Sample House' → XML can be stale.

GUIDs are stored in Windows bytes_le layout; Global/History is an episode-GUID table: header (count 848 at 0x0e and again at 0x362), 4 owner-GUID slots at 0x16 (e340d1fc-19c1-4200-9ff0-415bc126641d), a 190-entry u32 array at 0x6a, then 848 (racbasic) / 1017 (rstbasic) 17-byte records at 0x366 (16-byte GUID + 0x28). Record 0 == BasicFileInfo 'Unique Document GUID / last-reload-latest episode GUID' (racbasic e6a03f8e-9e4e-4cfc-ae41-c3c559e42d55, rstbasic 34447475-c1fb-44d1-b0f8-1adaa86cdbe1) — verified; the History GUIDs occur nowhere else in the file.

Constant workset GUID e3e052f8-0156-11d5-9301-0000863f27ad (v1, MAC-based) is byte-identical in racbasic/rstbasic/racadvanced/rmebasic at Contents+0x46 (after AString 'GLOBAL'), Global/PartitionTable+0x0a (before 'Workset1'), and inside partition members — a stable cross-file anchor; the app GUID 34b22600-3ed6-44b3-b4f1-6596f4d52b43 precedes every 'Autodesk Revit' AString (Global/Latest +0x3cf) and every inter-block marker record.

BasicFileInfo (2,171 B, both files) exact layout decoded: header, AStrings Format@0x0e, Build@0x1a, path@0x42, Identity nil GUID@0xd7, locale ENU@0x123, u32 version 16@0x12e, episode GUID@0x132, Unique Document GUID@0x17e, increments '16'@0x1ca, Model Identity@0x1d2, Author 'Autodesk Revit'@0x21f, ClientAppName@0x23f, then a UTF-16 key:value text block at 0x265–0x878 framed by SINGLE-BYTE CRLFs (0x263, 0x879) — the cause of the odd-offset 'garbage' when decoding the whole stream as UTF-16.

Partitions carving is incomplete: racbasic's 1,068 carved gzip members cover 16.53 of 18.51 MB; 164 raw gaps contain an uncompressed AString record 'Data generated by Autodesk® Revit®' + app GUID immediately before the next gzip member, and raw-inflating 132 bytes past one marker yields another 37,395-byte block the carver missed (first marker at raw offset 0x6074fa). The scanner now sweeps these gaps as 'Partitions__15 [rawgap]'.

Provenance strings are abundant: usernames (loboarch ×16, campbes ×8, zhangg, xuew, guanq, hansonje) in Global/DocumentIncrementTable (a per-increment log); author paths (C:\Users\hansonje\Desktop\..., OneDrive - Autodesk\FY-2021 Projects, D:\PF_Root\8.0, F:\Revit 2013) in partition element records (image/keynote/family paths); TransmissionData is a UTF-16 XML of external file references + last-save path; RevitPreview4.0 is a serialized FilePreview/ARasterImage object wrapping a PNG.

Formats/Latest is ASCII-only schema (21.5k length-prefixed ASCII class/field/C++ type strings, 3 UTF-16 hits); Global/ContentDocuments holds only 33 UTF-16 strings (project-browser labels + DB-link defaults) in 5.1 MB; the ~1,500 ForgeTypeId unit-schema JSON documents inside Global/Latest are byte-garbled in racbasic and heavily scrambled in rstbasic (flagged to the Latest agent as either a front-coded encoding or a bad inflate).
confidence: High for: AString encoding, ProjectInformation param map decode and the -1006316..-1006321 BuiltInParameter ids, Unique Document GUID = History[0], per-stream string taxonomy, BasicFileInfo layout, workset GUID constancy, rawgap marker records. Medium (labelled [hypothesis] in the doc): the -1019xxx / -1140934 / -1015223 param-id names, meanings of record framing bytes and PartitionTable/History header fields, the interpretation of the garbled Global/Latest JSON.
open_questions: Are the garbled/scrambled ForgeTypeId JSON documents in Global/Latest a real front-coded/interleaved string encoding, or a bad inflate/carve of that stream (racbasic member consumed 116,552 of 117,192 bytes; rstbasic far more scrambled)?

What is in the ~2 MB of high-entropy raw gaps of Partitions/15 beyond the 164 'Data generated by Autodesk® Revit®' marker records — undecoded deflate segments (one raw-inflated to 37,395 bytes) mean the current carver misses element data.
Meaning of the Global/History header: the 4 GUID slots (e340d1fc-19c1-4200-9ff0-415bc126641d ×3 + nil), the 190-entry u32 array at 0x6a, and the per-record trailing byte 0x28.

Rule for when a type record materialises the family-name AString ('Basic Wall' present in rstbasic, null ff ff ff ff in racbasic) and the class/field ids around names (d1 0c / d0 11 / 3b 01 on levels, 09 04 vs 97 04 on wall types).
Confirmation of the inferred parameter-id names -1019005..-1019008 (project org/building/author), -1140934 (assembly code) and -1015223 (type description) against the RevitAPI BuiltInParameter enum.
Semantics of the small ids in Global/PartitionTable (0x160 / 0x338) and Contents beyond GUID + name; whether Contents can carry a last-saved-by username (rstadvanced shows 'Steven Campbell').
next_steps: A6/A1: re-carve Partitions on the block framing (a gzip 1f 8b header is only one sub-record inside a block); recover the missed segments (start with the 93,127-byte gap right after racbasic member 095 and the marker gaps), then re-run strings_scan.py to complete the index.

A5: locate the ForgeTypeId unit JSON documents in Global/Latest (racbasic +0x221bb) and determine whether the byte garbling is an inflate artefact; compare against the pristine schema JSON shipped with Revit / the Forge schemas.

Build a param-map decoder from the verified layout (u32 count, then int64 BuiltInParameter id + typed value; text = AString) starting from the ProjectInformation record (racbasic Partitions/15 095 +0x5580) and generalise to numeric values (level elevation doubles at 043 +0x37e0 area).

Use History record 0 == BasicFileInfo Unique Document GUID and the constant workset GUID e3e052f8-0156-11d5-9301-0000863f27ad as fixed anchors in a rvtinspect CLI (A11); add `strings_scan.py --all` to the E1 verify harness (~30 min) once the dach carve is complete.
Cross-check the strings_<file>.jsonl 'name' + len_prefixed rows against Global/ElemTable ids to attach element ids to every located name (needs the ElemTable decoder from A4).
